entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit customer support. Your call is very important to us. Please hold while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for calling VeloFit, my name is Alex, how can I help you today?
Finally! I've been on hold forever. I need to return this VeloBand Pulse. It's junk.
I understand your frustration. I'm happy to help you with a return. Can I get your order number or the email address associated with the purchase?
It's [customer email address]. And hurry it up, I don't have all day.
Thank you. I see your order here. You purchased the VeloBand Pulse. Can you tell me why you're looking to return it?
It's not tracking my sleep properly, the heart rate monitor is all over the place, and frankly, the app is a nightmare. It’s just a terrible smart watch. I want my money back.

I apologize for the issues you're experiencing with the VeloBand Pulse. I understand your desire to return it. Our standard return policy allows for returns within 90 days of purchase for a full refund. Let me initiate the return process for you.
Ninety days? Really? I thought it was shorter than that. Well, that’s good news, I guess. I bought it, like, two weeks ago. Maybe 15 days ago or so.

Yes, the 90 days return policy applies. I'll generate a prepaid shipping label for you. You'll receive it in your email within the next hour. Just pack up the VeloBand Pulse in its original packaging, attach the label, and drop it off at any [Shipping Company Name] location. Once we receive the returned item, we'll process your refund. Please allow 7-10 business days for the refund to reflect in your account.
Okay, that sounds good. So I should expect an email with the label in an hour? And the refund takes about 10 days? Just want to be clear.

That’s correct. You'll receive the email with the shipping label within one hour, and the refund will take approximately 7-10 business days to process after we receive the returned VeloBand Pulse. Is there anything else I can help you with today?
No, I think that's it. Thanks for the help. I appreciate you making this easy.
You're very welcome! We appreciate your business. Have a great day!
